purpose: ADR-0085 opt-in daemon resource qualification; not a performance-contract observation
notes: All request outputs and stderr were compared byte-for-byte to a direct invocation over the same fixture.
RSS is ps resident set in KiB sampled every 100 ms; it includes allocator high-water memory and is not live query charge.
Source bytes count accepted SourceSnapshot text; they are not a complete host heap estimate and overlap retained query charge.
Query/pin peaks are sampled after requests before idle-host eviction, not continuously inside compilation.
Elapsed seconds are diagnostic context, not fresh_source_to_native_v1 or daemon performance observations.
Idle timeout was explicitly 60 seconds for this isolated harness; production default remains 30 minutes.
The first run checked process absence immediately after stop; the later two used the final bounded five-second OS reaping check.

lifecycle.evidence: Original harness returned success after stop and immediate ps-absence assertion.
